description: Ask Sentinel, a security agent on NEAR, whether an account is safe to pay. It is a paid service: the server answers HTTP 402 with a price, this tool pays it through your AgentGuard vault (so your vault's rules apply, and the payee must be allowed by them), then returns the check and the payment tx. It never pays more than max_price_near. Use the free agentguard_check_address for routine checks; use this when you want a second opinion.

max_price_near.description: Most you will pay for this check, default "0.02"

name: agentguard_sentinel_check
title: Buy Sentinel's paid address check (x402)
